scope: One immutable seed-0 development run testing whether a feed-forward residual policy can amortize an already selected calibrated channel-aware OPEX teacher.

novelty_position.role: PA-RL-like policy-amortization control and possible engineering extension
novelty_position.prohibited_claim: Do not present generic frozen-critic teacher optimization followed by policy distillation as the primary method novelty.
novelty_position.scientific_use: Tests whether the gap between direct frozen-Q adapter optimization and per-state CA-OPEX is principally an amortization/optimization problem.

contamination_and_selection.interpretation: Every output is exploratory development evidence, even though execution is frozen and fail-closed. It cannot be relabeled as held-out confirmation.

hypothesis.limitation: Direct end-to-end expected-Q optimization of the residual network may fail to amortize the strong per-state CA-OPEX solution through a noisy nonconvex policy objective.
hypothesis.intervention: Generate a fresh K=8, T=2 calibrated CA-OPEX target online for every sampled source-train state, then fit the same bounded residual MLP by normalized command MSE.
predictions_if_supported: The normalized teacher-command MSE decreases during training.
The distilled student improves over the paired inverse-only anchor on the fixed matched-development episodes.
The student recovers a positive fraction of the already frozen CA-OPEX teacher improvement while using zero critic calls at deployment.
hypothesis.counterevidence: Failure to improve over inverse-only despite low teacher-command MSE would indicate behavioral compounding or critic-teacher mismatch rather than merely difficult policy optimization.

frozen_teacher_result.selection_status: eta=0.1 selected from the predeclared eta grid on these same ten development episodes

training.resume_semantics: --updates is the total target; exact continuation restores teacher, minibatch, optimizer, and global RNG states

evaluation.selection_rule: retain and report all ten requested episodes

comparison.selection_rule: No run or episode may be excluded; report negative and greater-than-one recovery fractions unchanged.
